items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: We would play together but we could hear them and appreciate their great talent, of a guy like Teagarden and a guy like Miff Moe.

ctx.x: Of course, when I joined McKinney's band and Don had told me about Tommy because Don, when Don was writing for Whiteman, Tommy Dorsey and his brother Jimmy was in Whiteman's band. That's when I first heard about Tommy Dorsey. I didn't know nothing about him because he, you know -- Miff Moe was -- [handwritten correction: 'Moe' written above 'Hoe']

Well, black and white bands didn't get to see one another enough. We would play together but we could hear them and appreciate their great talent, of a guy like Teagarden and a guy like Miff Moe. [handwritten correction: 'Moe' written above 'Hoe']
Well, with Don's band we got to play across from Isham Jones. [handwritten correction: 'Isham' written above 'Eisam']
